title: Try more tweaks, find more wins
intro: 1,000 simulated studies in which every tweak is the same setting as the baseline, with three seeds per arm compared by a t-test. The share of studies that report at least one significant tweak, without a correction and with Bonferroni, and the textbook value 1 - 0.95^k for independent tests.
columns: share of studies with a false discovery
